# The fields no projection or fixture of the inventory guide's search and
# messaging calls may carry (PRD #571, *Only the fields the program reads*): an
# access policy names the account's principals, a security option its settings,
# and an endpoint or a bootstrap address a host with the account's name in it.
#
# One list, two checks, which used to keep a hand-written copy each and could
# drift apart silently (review finding on PR #639): test/examples'
# TestInventoryGuideSearchAndKafkaFixturesCarryOnlyTheFieldsTheProgramReads, which
# reads every recorded fixture's keys at any depth, and test/site's
# TestInventoryGuideSearchAndKafkaCallsKeepOnlyTheFieldsTheyRead, which reads the
# --query of every `aws opensearch`, `aws opensearchserverless` and `aws kafka`
# command. Both read this file, test/examples through
# inventoryguidekeys_test.go and test/site through inventory_test.go, by relative
# path. A field added here is excluded from both, and must be, or one half of the
# promise holds while the other lets the field through.
#
# A record is `key: <field>`, one field the calls must not name, or
# `prefix: <prefix>`, a field no name may start with (MSK's ZooKeeper connection
# strings and its broker addresses are one entry each with a prefix, since each
# has a suffix: BootstrapBrokerStringTls, BootstrapBrokerStringSaslScram, ...).
# A record line holds its record and nothing else: a comment goes on a line of its
# own, and no record appears twice. Both readers reject either, since a trailing
# comment would become part of the field's name and a repeat would hide its first
# copy.
# Add a key only with the reason PRD #571 excludes it, as the file's first
# paragraph gives for these.
key: AccessPolicies
key: AdvancedSecurityOptions
key: CognitoOptions
key: Endpoint
key: Endpoints
key: DomainEndpointOptions
key: collectionEndpoint
key: dashboardEndpoint
key: bootstrapAddress
key: osProfile
key: connectivityEndpoints
# An HDInsight cluster's worker role carries the scripts the cluster runs and
# their parameters (scriptActions) and the subnet it sits in
# (virtualNetworkProfile), as it carries osProfile: PRD #571 keeps none of the
# four, and the guide's query packs the worker role field by field.
key: scriptActions
key: virtualNetworkProfile
prefix: ZookeeperConnectString
prefix: BootstrapBroker
